info.name: GraphQLTimeMachine
info.description:
Time Machine (future publish date) behaviour of the Page API and the GraphQL page query.

Setup builds a page whose contentlets have versions published now, versions scheduled ten days ahead, a version scheduled inside the five-minute grace window, a working-only version and a banner whose image changes between versions, plus URL-mapped content (one item unpublished). The Time Machine folder requests the page with no date, the current date, a grace-window date and a future date, and checks which versions the page, the rendered HTML, the banner image servlet and GraphQL return. Cleanup removes everything it created.

The requests run in order and share one session: the /dA/ banner checks rely on the Time Machine date the page request before them stored in the session.
